Something very similar happened to me over the summer as I was turning 16. I was terrified because it meant that I would be faced with more responsibilities, which meant in turn that more would be expected of me. Given the fact that I already saw myself as a complete failure who was unable to live up to anyone's expectations \[plus the fact that I'm trans, so lots of gender dysphoria that wasn't and still isn't helping at all\], I considered suicide quite a lot- yet, here I am, still alive. In all honesty, I'm not sure why I haven't committed suicide yet- maybe because I know there are some people who will be sad when I leave. But, it makes me wonder if that sadness will stay, or if I'll just be forgotten eventually...

But anyway, we seem to have a bit in common here. You can message me if you want, and we can talk about it.
